$comment: Map a product id to a production GLB. Example: "jacket-pulse": { "url": "/models/jacket-pulse.glb", "scale": 1, "offset": [0, 0, 0], "rotation": [0, 0, 0] }. Units are metres, Y-up, facing +Z. Hanging garments: origin at the hanger hook. Shoes, accessories and devices: origin at the base centre. Materials whose name contains 'fabric' or 'body' follow the colour picker.
